cc:Work.dc:title: FreeFG 1.1.3.1 with HelixSR — Cyberpunk 2077
cc:Work.dc:description: Cyberpunk 2077 2.5 · AMD BC-250 · 1440p Quality. SDR, No FG: output 71.95 FPS (95% CI 71.58–72.32), game 71.95 FPS, n=4; SDR, Intel XeFG 2×: output 86.34 FPS (95% CI 86.09–86.59), game 43.17 FPS, n=4, derived cost 9.265 ms per generated frame; SDR, FreeFG 2×: output 108.36 FPS (95% CI 108.00–108.73), game 54.18 FPS, n=4, derived cost 4.558 ms per generated frame; SDR, Intel XeFG 3× (unofficial): output 93.89 FPS (95% CI 93.82–93.96), game 31.30 FPS, n=4, derived cost 9.027 ms per generated frame; SDR, FreeFG 3× (unofficial): output 131.67 FPS (95% CI 130.62–132.72), game 43.89 FPS, n=4, derived cost 4.443 ms per generated frame; SDR, Intel XeFG 4× (unofficial): output 97.95 FPS (95% CI 97.63–98.26), game 24.49 FPS, n=4, derived cost 8.980 ms per generated frame; SDR, FreeFG 4× (unofficial): output 151.06 FPS (95% CI 150.77–151.35), game 37.77 FPS, n=4, derived cost 4.194 ms per generated frame; HDR10, No FG: output 71.64 FPS (95% CI 71.46–71.81), game 71.64 FPS, n=4; HDR10, Intel XeFG 2×: output 84.92 FPS (95% CI 84.74–85.09), game 42.46 FPS, n=4, derived cost 9.593 ms per generated frame; HDR10, FreeFG 2×: output 106.52 FPS (95% CI 106.24–106.80), game 53.26 FPS, n=4, derived cost 4.816 ms per generated frame; HDR10, Intel XeFG 3× (unofficial): output 91.72 FPS (95% CI 91.53–91.92), game 30.57 FPS, n=4, derived cost 9.374 ms per generated frame; HDR10, FreeFG 3× (unofficial): output 129.61 FPS (95% CI 129.32–129.90), game 43.20 FPS, n=4, derived cost 4.593 ms per generated frame; HDR10, Intel XeFG 4× (unofficial): output 95.36 FPS (95% CI 95.29–95.43), game 23.84 FPS, n=4, derived cost 9.329 ms per generated frame; HDR10, FreeFG 4× (unofficial): output 146.12 FPS (95% CI 145.83–146.41), game 36.53 FPS, n=4, derived cost 4.472 ms per generated frame. 4 runs per condition · whiskers: 95% CI across runs. ms / FG = (1000 / game FPS − 1000 / no-FG FPS). divided by (factor − 1). Derived added time; lower is faster.. 3×/4× (unofficial): separate MFG Unlocker 1.6.0. with XeFGModel=default · DLSS FG input → XeFG. High, RT off · 1706×960 → 2560×1440 · headless 240 Hz. HelixSR 2.0.0 · reactive mask off · warm caches. Measured 26 October 2026. Source: docs/data/cyberpunk-helixsr/data.json.
